narrative.overview: A studio still life of real Peruvian crafts behind the store name written enormous in translucent white, on cool grey, in the logo red. Cards, figures and a material index float over the photo; below, categories, a 3D top-products carousel, material tiles, a silver-restoration service, a filterable grid of available pieces, a red closing panel and a dark footer.
keyCharacteristics: Cool grey page with a matching hero grey that the header shares at the top of the home page.
Wordmark layered between the hero photo and a cut-out of its products.
One brand red: action fill, red text and fields, muted red-grey for light display lines.
Geist light against bold; no italics; no eyebrow labels.
White cards with offset soft shadows, concentric radii, no borders.
Square full-height search (white) and cart (red) blocks at the header right edge.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: The logo red is the only interface hue, always at full strength; WhatsApp green only on WhatsApp actions.

rules.name: The Large-Red-Grey Rule
rules.body: Muted Clay Red only at lede size or larger.

rules.name: The Hero-Grey Seam Rule
rules.body: Anything touching the hero photo backdrop uses #dfe1e6 exactly.

rules.name: The Two-Weight Heading Rule
rules.body: Light muted red plus one bold red word that carries the meaning.

rules.name: The Upright Type Rule
rules.body: No italic or oblique type anywhere.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No uppercase letter-spaced labels above headings.

rules.name: The Wordmark-Behind Rule
rules.body: The wordmark sits between the studio photo and its product cut-out; the three enter as one block.

dos: Use Hero Grey wherever something meets the hero photograph.
Regenerate the product cut-out whenever the hero photo changes.
Write section headings in two weights.
Use white cards with offset soft shadows and concentric radii.
Show real API numbers; keep owner figures as given.
Start every reveal from a visible default, with a reduced-motion fallback.
donts: Set body or small text in Muted Clay Red.
Add a second accent hue or red gradients.
Use italics, a second typeface or kicker labels.
Use zero-offset glows, hard offset shadows or card borders.
Add glass beyond the hero cards.
Invent artisans, testimonials, certifications or service details.
